name: MonarchCalloutBanner
title: CalloutBanner
summary: A banner for a screen or a section, with a tone, an optional title, one action and a dismiss button; also a compact notice that the view is narrowed.
whenToUse: For account and product messages that concern a whole screen or section: a trial, a maintenance window, a billing problem, a failed sync, or a narrowed scope such as "Showing tickets in Support".
whenNotToUse: For the status of one form or card, use MonarchInlineNotice. For a brief confirmation, use a snackbar through MonarchSnackbarHost. For a decision that blocks the flow, use AlertDialog.
api: @Composable fun MonarchCalloutBanner(message: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Info, variant: MonarchCalloutBannerVariant = MonarchCalloutBannerVariant.Callout, placement: MonarchCalloutBannerPlacement = MonarchCalloutBannerPlacement.Section, title: String? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, action: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onDismiss: (() -> Unit)? = null, dismissIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, announcement: MonarchBannerAnnouncement = MonarchBannerAnnouncement.None, toneLabel: String? = null, dismissLabel: String? = null)

options.name: message
options.description: The message; one or two sentences.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the banner. The banner fills the width it is given.

options.name: tone
options.description: Neutral, Info, Success, Warning or Danger: the colors and the spoken tone name.

options.name: variant
options.description: Callout, or Scope: a compact notice in caption text with the action at the end.

options.name: placement
options.description: Section: rounded, bordered. Page: a full-width strip with square corners and a bottom border.

options.name: icon
options.description: An icon at the start in the tone color. Hidden from TalkBack; Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: action
options.description: An action, for example a small MonarchButton. Under the text in the callout, at the end in the scope notice.

options.name: onDismiss
options.description: Adds a dismiss button. The app removes the banner.

options.name: dismissIcon
options.description: The close mark of the dismiss button; without it the button shows its label as text.

options.name: announcement
options.description: None, Polite or Assertive: makes the text a live region.

options.name: toneLabel
options.description: The tone name read first. null uses monarch_calloutbanner_tone_info, _success, _warning or _danger.

options.name: dismissLabel
options.description: Label or TalkBack name of the dismiss button. null uses monarch_calloutbanner_dismiss, "Dismiss".

states.name: callout
states.description: Icon, title, message and an action under the text, with 12dp corners in a section.

states.name: scope
states.description: One compact line in caption text, 8dp corners, the action at the end.

states.name: page
states.description: Square corners and a border only at the bottom.

states.name: dismissible
states.description: A dismiss button at the end, when onDismiss is given. The app removes the banner.

states.name: announced
states.description: With Polite or Assertive the text is a live region.

appearance: The subtle background and border of the tone, with default text and muted message text under a title; the icon takes the strong color of the tone. The neutral banner sits on the subtle background with the default border. The same roles are used in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The banner does not hide itself: the web keeps its own open state when uncontrolled; here the app removes it in onDismiss. One action slot instead of the web's actions slot and actionPlacement option. No accent tone, because MonarchTone has none. The web landmark option has no equivalent; the web live option is the announcement parameter, which reuses MonarchBannerAnnouncement. Monarch bundles no icons: the web and iOS show a default icon per tone, here the app passes the icon, and the dismiss button shows the word Dismiss unless a dismissIcon is given. Insets are the app's: put a page banner under the top app bar or in the content of a Scaffold. The spoken tone name comes from the shared Monarch tone names (Information, Success, Warning, Error, AI), the same words as iOS. Deprecated (D7): the component's own string keys monarch_calloutbanner_tone_info, _success, _warning and _danger are now aliases of the shared names. An app that redefines one still gets its text, but they are removed no earlier than 2027-02-13 (90-day window, two patch releases); override the shared monarch_internal_tone_* names or pass toneLabel instead.
accessibility: The tone name, title and message are one TalkBack element, read in that order, so the tone does not depend on color; toneLabel replaces the tone name.
The neutral tone and the scope variant have no spoken tone name.
The icon is hidden from TalkBack.
The action and the dismiss button are separate buttons with 48dp touch targets; the dismiss button is named "Dismiss" unless dismissLabel says otherwise.
With announcement Polite or Assertive the text is a live region; by default the banner does not announce itself.
The dismiss button is at the end in both layout directions, and the text wraps at the largest font size.
edgeCases: Long titles and messages wrap; the banner grows taller.
A banner that is on the screen from the start should keep announcement None.
In the scope variant a long action label narrows the message; keep it short.

examples.title: Page banner with an action
examples.template:
MonarchCalloutBanner(
    message = {{body}},
    tone = {{tone|tone}},
    placement = MonarchCalloutBannerPlacement.{{placement|pascal}},
    title = {{title}},
    action = {
        MonarchButton(
            text = {{action.label}},
            onClick = {},
            variant = MonarchButtonVariant.{{action.variant|pascal}},
            size = MonarchButtonSize.{{action.size|pascal}},
        )
    },
    onDismiss = {},
)
examples.code:
MonarchCalloutBanner(
    message = "Add a payment method to keep your workspace and its data.",
    tone = MonarchTone.Accent,
    placement = MonarchCalloutBannerPlacement.Page,
    title = "Your trial ends in 3 days",
    action = {
        MonarchButton(
            text = "Choose a plan",
            onClick = {},
            variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary,
            size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm,
        )
    },
    onDismiss = {},
)
